EMBARGOED UNTIL RELEASE AT 8:30 a.m. EDT, Thursday, July 30, 2026

Personal Income and Outlays, June 2026

From the preceding month, the PCE price index for June was unchanged. Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index was also unchanged.

From the same month one year ago, the PCE price index for June increased 3.7 percent. Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 3.3 percent from one year ago.
